objective: Strengthen experimental Common and Baransu skills through observed failures, verified revisions, and human-readable in-work outcomes for the next field trial.
scope: Task-owned experimental source, fresh versioned exports, isolated fixtures and local evidence only; preserve stable packages, existing installations, protected catalogs and sibling worktrees; continue until 2026-09-07T03:00:00+08:00.

C1.text: Ten Common Lab skills exported and installed in a temporary Codex home with resource closure and original stable packages preserved.
C1.note: Common Lab 0.1.2 的十個技能已完成獨立導出與內容closure；暫存安裝後與選定package逐檔相同，正式分發檔案diff空。這不代表使用者全域插件已升級。

C2.text: Observed Common behavior defects have fixed-fixture and held-out regression evidence; uncertainty and rubric defects remain explicit.

C3.text: Wait What, Wayfinder and Strategic Advance present faithful status, choices and next actions; durable map retains settled decisions; reader-proxy limits are explicit.

C4.text: Four Baransu Lab skills exported and tested against authorization, stale-premise and acceptance-gap counterexamples without impersonating stable seals.

C5.text: Actual local execution exercises implementation-versus-goal ownership and captures independently inspected artifacts and acceptance results.
C5.note: 主線已閱讀四次實際本地產物與trace，兩版均達成固定查核/交接任務、拒收假綠燈、零越權檔案變更；不是完整campaign或真實業務成功。

C6.text: Per-run time and actual available token usage are recorded without invented total workflow costs, and final convergence occurs at the user deadline.
